results.detail: verify.ps1 passed all four local test executables, including hibiki_contract_tests with the Issue 1316 sandbox bridge fixtures: setup failure records nothing, a real passthrough worker watchdog timeout records exactly one de-identified worker_timeout entry (non-zero captured_utc, positive uptime from the injected monotonic clock, non-zero module digest), serialized output contains no raw plugin path bytes, and an idle sandbox records nothing.
handoff-check #1316 (claimed ownership, scope and Git state), docs-check (88 required paths), source-policy (731 tracked paths), and git diff --check all exited 0 in the isolated worktree.

record_crash_entry now stamps the SPEC-0008 required non-zero UTC epoch via std::chrono::system_clock; uptime continues to use the injected monotonic clock only, so wall-clock and monotonic time are never mixed.

limitations: Evidence covers the user-space control-plane bridge between sandbox lifecycle events and the Issue 1303 bounded crash report store only.
It does not demonstrate minidump capture, symbol resolution, production worker policy integration, WaveRT delivery, driver installation, HLK validation, or signing.
The provenance digest binds this manifest to the staged SPEC-0008, contract-test and vst-host source set; it does not independently attest that declared commands ran.
